description: This file contains the implementation of the 'find' and 'replace' dialog for CKEditor, including functions for text search, highlighting, and replacement within the editor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.style
classes.description: Represents a style that can be applied to a range of content within CKEditor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.walker
classes.description: A DOM walker used for traversing text nodes within a range.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.range
classes.description: Represents a range of content within the editor's DOM.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Checks if a node is a non-empty, editable text node.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Checks if a node is a block boundary element that is not editable.

methods.name: g
methods.description: Copies values between find and replace input fields based on the dialog type.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Initializes the find or replace dialog, setting up event handlers and UI elements.
